fields.text: When `opts.DocPaths` is empty in `SeedDocs`, previously seeded `source_doc_path` files from active `doc-seed` entries that are no longer matched by `ResolveDocSeedGlobs` (e.g., deleted files) are included in the reconciliation pass so their entries are deterministically retired with `source_doc_deleted: <path>`.

Extracted a stable normalized key hint (`<heading>:<bold-prefix>` or table key) when present so updating the prose of a named rule or table row amends the existing `docseed-<hash>` entry in place rather than churning entry IDs.
